leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: Past Simple: Irregular Verbs
leadIn.content: Completed past actions with irregular verbs: Yesterday Tom woke up early, drank coffee, and took the train to work.

meaningCheck.question: "I visited Paris in 2019." — Is the trip to Paris completely finished?
options: Yes, the action finished at a specific completed time in the past
No, the speaker is still in Paris right now
The trip will happen next year
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Past simple refers to finished actions at a specific time in the past.

meaningCheck.question: "She lived in Rome for two years." — Does she live in Rome now?
options: Yes, she still lives in Rome
No, she does not live in Rome anymore
She is moving to Rome tomorrow
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Past simple indicates the period of living in Rome is completely over.

form.title: Form & Structure: Past Simple: Irregular Verbs
form.content: Subject + irregular past verb (e.g. went, saw, had, came). Negative: Subject + didn't + base verb. Question: Did + subject + base verb?

controlledPractice.question: Fix: 'Did you saw him?'
controlledPractice.explanation: After 'did', the main verb returns to its base form: see, not saw.
